message: The owner's Beta and release apps are theirs. Harnesses install Lukotta Dev.app (LUKOTTA_BRANDING=dev LUKOTTA_DEVTOOLS=1 ./build-app.sh); scripts/update-test.sh is the one script that replaces an installed app.
No build, dev included, deletes a saved drive password. Only the person's Forget button or a confirmed uninstall removes one.
The Swift tree is sources/, lowercase. On this case-insensitive disk git add Sources/... leaves tracked files unstaged. Name paths as git ls-files prints them.
Lukotta's os_log lines never appear in log show on this Mac, at any level. Build a foreground instrument (--drive sweep) rather than reading an absence as evidence.
A new or changed string gets "audit": false on its entry until it is audited.
